decision_rationale: This is a short Nature Methods article previewing EpiAgent, not a primary model paper. It describes chromatin accessibility as 'cell sentences' and reports prediction/knockout tasks, but no substantive natural-language text component or explicit generative mechanism.
evidence_snippet: "EpiAgent, a transformer-based foundation model pretrained on approximately 5 million cells and over 35 billion tokens"; "encoding chromatin accessibility as 'cell sentences'"; "enabled perturbation response prediction and in silico chromatin region knockouts"
